$comment: CODM detector pack. All ROIs, texts and colours are UNVERIFIED until G1/G2 check them on corpus footage (source: docs/evidence/2026-10-27-g1-live-reference.md). Weights, windows and cooldowns are null: G3 proposes them from labelled data. No private names here; names come from data/profile.local.json at runtime. `version` is the pack version for every file in this folder; version history: CHANGELOG.md.

detectors.name: MVP + IGN

rois.label: Post-match MVP screen: MVP text and the name to its right
rois.note: Live capture 2: MVP at x 0.02-0.11, y 0.41-0.47; the name sits right of and below it (x 0.11-0.33, y 0.47-0.55) and slides in from the left.

rois.label: End screen (MP scoreboard or top 3, BR squad cards): MVP badge on a player card, the name beside it
rois.note: Pair MVP with the name box on the same card (right of or below the badge). MP top-3 cards: badge at y 0.84-0.87 under the card. MP full scoreboard: one MVP badge per team (own team y 0.65, enemy y 0.84), so the badge must pair with the name on its own row. BR squad cards: badge at y 0.78-0.80 under the MVP's avatar, name at y 0.81-0.82. Lobby Like toasts also carry an MVP tag (y 0.28-0.38) and profile/history pages show MVP-like text; exclude lobby and profile frames.

detectors.note: Match-level boost. Post-match MVP screen (postmatch_left) verified on live capture 2. End screens carry MVP badges for every MVP (both teams, teammates), so the badge counts only when paired with the profile name on the same card. Lobby Like toasts and profile pages are excluded.

detectors.name: Impact Play + IGN

rois.label: IMPACT PLAY header, top centre
KILLED BY panel with name, top left

detectors.note: Post-match replay of the best sequence (about 22 s) with a REC marker. While on screen it suppresses M3/M4 (rule suppress_medals_in_replay). Matched back to the live timeline later.

detectors.name: Medals

rois.label: Medal banner: badge and label, top centre (label text at y 0.21-0.30)
Medal text stack with +N, right of centre

referenceDataset.layout: one subfolder per medal (slug of the medal text), crops inside, index.jsonl with one record per crop

detectors.note: Own HUD, no name match. Medals have a class: positive (clip signal, weight set by G3) or reference (weight 0, never a clip reason; detected and logged with crops into referenceDataset). Class and weight are data: promote a reference medal by changing its class to positive, clipReason to true and weight to a number. Relentless and Brutal are UNVERIFIED (not seen on footage). Bloodthirsty spelling seen on full-screen live capture 2. Normal Kill and First Blood are deliberately not medals. Suppressed while M2 is shown. User decisions 2026-10-27; the move of Revenge, Bloodthirsty, Saboteur, Berserker and Keep it Fresh to reference is an interpretation of the user's positive list (to confirm).

detectors.name: Yellow +N points

rois.label: Shares the M3 text stack ROI; +N sits at its left (x 0.58-0.66)

detectors.note: Action-density signal: a burst of popups in a short window. Seen: +125, +127, +252, +254, +256, small +2/+4. Suppressed while M2 is shown. G1: post-match XP screens show +NNNN outside the stack; count +N only with a medal or kill text in the same stack.

detectors.name: MP kill feed

rois.label: Kill feed, bottom left, up to 3 lines

detectors.note: Killer, weapon icon, victim. Own lines: earlier corpus crops showed the user name in pale yellow; live capture 2 shows own lines on a red/pink background (colour not measured, UNVERIFIED). Lines reach x 0.62 (2% of lines past 0.58); the scan slack covers it.

detectors.name: BR kill feed

rois.label: Kill feed, top left, above the squad list
rois.note: Killer names start at x 0.01; the vertical cutout shows x >= 0.111 only, so the killer side is cut there. Full screen: the squad list (with the user's own name) shares this band in smaller text (height 0.01-0.02); feed text is 0.025-0.04 high, so boxes under minTextHeight are ignored.

detectors.note: Line: killer, weapon icon, knock-or-kill icon (falling figure = knock, skull = elimination), victim, count. Icon detection not specified yet. Own lines have an orange background on the corpus; on live capture 2 the lines of the user and squad mates have a purple bar (colour not measured, UNVERIFIED). G1: in the vertical cutout the killer side is cut off; own kills show only as an orange line with the victim name. Live capture 2: an own-event notification at top centre (x 0.28-0.46, y 0.17-0.21) shows 'attacker [knock|skull] You' when the user is downed or killed and '[knock] victim' when the user knocks someone.

detectors.name: Multi-kill / killstreak card

rois.label: Card, left of centre: score, name, nX MULTI-KILL / On a N killstreak
Squad banner, top centre: teammate or user name and nX MULTI-KILL / On a N killstreak

detectors.note: Shows for other players too, so the name match is required. Text forms seen: nX MULTI-KILL, 5+ MULTI-KILL (BR), On a N killstreak! with N 5, 10, 20, 25 (other N values UNVERIFIED). In BR the squad list always shows the user's name, so the name must be inside the banner ROI, not anywhere on the frame. Correction 2026-10-28: X1 appears in BR as well as MP. A5b BR has 32 X1 banner_br hits, 5 with the profile name in the banner (docs/evidence/2026-10-27-p2b-w1-coverage-capture.md); the P2a gate note "seen in MP only" was wrong.

detectors.name: Own-kill counter text

rois.label: Yellow ELIMINATED / KNOCKED DOWN and N KILL(S), right of centre (animated zoom-in)

detectors.note: Own HUD: no name match. ELIMINATED, SQUAD ELIMINATED, ASSIST ELIMINATED or KNOCKED DOWN, right of centre, animated zoom-in. KNOCKED DOWN sits at y 0.39-0.44, ELIMINATED at y 0.43-0.47 with N DAMAGE DEALT or N KILL(S) beneath (to y 0.50). Live capture 2: that N KILL(S) is the user's own count (the corpus case near the top was a player banner). OCR often garbles DOWN (DOON, DORN).

detectors.name: FINAL KILLCAM + killer name

rois.label: FINAL KILLCAM label, top centre
rois.note: Seen in 1 corpus clip / 5 frames (G1); box is the measured text extent.

rois.label: Killer name shown with the FINAL KILLCAM label
rois.note: Position UNVERIFIED: wide band under and around the label until a capture shows where the killer name sits.

detectors.note: User decision 2026-10-27: positive signal ONLY when the streamer name (IGN or any profile variant) is shown as the killer. Without the name there is no signal. Both cases are logged (matched true and false) as evidence records for tuning. Never an N1 event.

detectors.name: Match result

rois.label: VICTORY / DEFEAT word, centre
rois.note: 2026-11-07 practice: VICTORY x 0.416-0.584, y 0.372-0.476 (1 frame at 0.5 fps); DEFEAT x 0.417-0.582, y 0.371-0.477 (2 frames). ROI approved by the user 2026-11-07.

detectors.note: User decision 2026-11-07: marks the end of a match and its result, for the won-match highlight (every own kill of a won match). Context only: never a clip signal or weight. The whole OCR box must read VICTORY or DEFEAT (the scoreboard top line and small text elsewhere stay out by the ROI).

detectors.name: Killcam

rois.label: KILLCAM label, top left (MP)
rois.note: Live capture 2: KILLCAM at x 0.04-0.13, y 0.03-0.08 in 11/11 killcam frames.

rois.label: KILL CAM label, top centre (BR)
rois.note: Live capture 2: KILL CAM at x 0.46-0.54, y 0.02-0.05 in 3/3 kill cams.

rois.label: Attacker name in the header 'attacker N VS N victim', top centre (MP); the user name sits right of VS
rois.note: Live capture 2: attacker name at x 0.35-0.46, y 0.01-0.05; victim (user) at x 0.55-0.64.

rois.label: KILLED BY card with the attacker name, bottom left (MP)
rois.note: Live capture 2: name at x 0.25-0.38, y 0.86-0.90. An attackers panel (x 0.01-0.26, y 0.36-0.45) also lists names with damage.

rois.label: Killer:<name> line, bottom centre (BR kill cam)
rois.note: Live capture 2: x 0.38-0.51, y 0.84-0.87 in 3/3 kill cams; Weapon:<name> sits left of it on the same row. Other Killer: text in BR is an achievement title, not the kill cam.

detectors.note: The user died. Negative signal; never raises a score. MP KILLCAM label is top left (mostly outside the vertical cutout); BR shows KILL CAM top centre. FINAL KILLCAM (MP, top centre, x 0.45-0.56, y 0.055-0.093) is the match-ending kill, not a death of the user, so it is not an N1 event (see K1). Killer-name ROIs are read for logging; N1 never needs a name match.

detectors.name: Downed / redeploy

rois.label: HELP ME button, right
Waiting for Revival Flight, bottom centre (spectating)
rois.note: Live capture 2: y 0.74 while spectating a teammate.

rois.label: Waiting for Revival Flight, top centre (during the kill cam)
rois.note: Live capture 2: x 0.43-0.57, y 0.09-0.12 with a countdown below.

detectors.note: The user is down or waiting to redeploy. Negative signal or end-of-life marker.

suppressionRules.reason: The Impact Play replay (REC overlay) repeats the match medals; counting them again would double count.

endScreenRule.note: User decision 2026-10-27. Detect every end screen that appears (MVP, Impact Play, FINAL KILLCAM); a match may show more than one. Check the profile name on each screen separately. Each screen with the name is positive, but it counts once per match for scoring, and every named screen is listed as a reason. No screen with the name means no signal. No end screen has to appear.
